items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Dave Birkin's too was pretty light. He was a trombone player.

ctx.x: They were there before Tom Brown got there. Who was that? Johnny Stein was a drummer, right? Uh-huh. And Jimmy Durante was playing piano. He was playing. No, Johnny Stein. I don't know. He was playing. They were there, and supposedly not. I started to write a moment. Old-time guys have told me. Yeah. And I've seen it in a couple of books, as a matter of fact. Yeah, but that's... Who else? Yellow Nunes was in that band, huh, dear?

Didn't I tell you, Johnny? My kid, maybe, huh? Johnny. Did not tell you, Johnny? No, it was Jimmy Durante. The same Jimmy Durante. Yeah. Johnny Stein. I was there. Did not tell you everything they write is all wrong? I wouldn't contradict it? Yeah. Say that guy played good clown in Bacay, didn't he? Oh, she? Yeah. I feel good. Yeah. He was a jiggory in the music bar. He never played with no color for it. Do you remember Eddie Sherry? Eddie Sherry, I guess he was. Yeah. At a bowling shop. Yeah. At a bowling shop.…

I wasn't on the district here. Uh-huh. Didn't he have one plays, one steady plays? No. One of them worked two or three weeks in the time. Who was in the band. Yeah. Johnny Stein. Yellow Nunez. Eddie Edwards. Henry Ragus.
